C0139.title: Tianjin Dismantles Entire Criminal Chain of Game Account Trading Fraud Ring
keywords: Ministry of Public Security coordinated strike
C0139.summary: The Criminal Investigation Division of the Tianjin Public Security Bureau dismantled an entire criminal chain of a fraud ring using game account trading scams, arresting 17 suspects. The Ministry of Public Security launched a nationwide coordinated strike, solving 59 cases of fake game transaction fraud during the summer public security crackdown.

references.title: Tianjin Dismantles Entire Gang Scamming via Game Account Trading
